notes.title: May 10, 2023 Corrected update release notes
notes.content:
1. MainMenu : "EXIT" → Renamed to "RETURN TO TITLE "
2. Added "CLOSE APPLICATION" menu.
3. Added keyboard operation explanation menu "KEYBOARD CONTROLS’ EXPLANATIONS" to "How to play" (WEB link).
4. Balanced the upper limit of the frame rate to 60 frames for the monitor.
